stories.title: Witkoff and Kushner head to Kyiv for their first-ever visit after 'useful' Moscow talks with Putin
stories.reason: The Trump envoys' first trip to Ukraine since the war began carries a new US peace proposal, backed by a rare reciprocal pause on Kyiv-Moscow strikes negotiated to coincide with the visit.

stories.title: Philippines VP Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest warrant over alleged threat to assassinate Marcos
stories.reason: A sitting vice president was briefly subject to an arrest warrant over 2024 remarks threatening the president's life, a dramatic escalation of the political crisis already underway in her impeachment trial.

stories.title: Iran claims missile strikes on a US carrier and destroyer as US sinks an Iranian tanker in response
stories.reason: CENTCOM says both warships evaded the attack without injury, but this marks the third exchange of fire between the US and Iran in a single week after a month of relative calm.

stories.title: Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket becomes the first to reach orbit from European soil
stories.reason: The German startup's launch from Norway's Andøya Space Center is the first commercial flight to reach orbit from continental Europe, a milestone for the continent's push into the satellite launch market.

stories.title: Elon Musk's America PAC discloses first wave of midterm spending, targeting Texas and Maine Senate races
stories.reason: Musk has authorized up to $120 million for Republican candidates this cycle, with early money flowing to Ken Paxton in Texas and against Susan Collins in Maine.

stories.title: Google patches actively exploited Chrome zero-day, the sixth of 2026
stories.reason: CVE-2026-85046, a V8 engine flaw allowing remote code execution, has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list with a September 18 patch deadline for federal agencies.

stories.title: Oil surges nearly 9% for the week, its strongest weekly gain since mid-July
stories.reason: The rally reflects mounting concern over supply disruptions as US-Iran strikes resumed this week after roughly a month of calm, keeping pressure on global inflation and the Fed's rate path.

stories.title: Nepal rescues a 60-year-old woman trapped for 10 days as flood death toll reaches 1,375
stories.reason: Stranded villagers are now lining up for makeshift zip-line crossings to reach home, while more than 5,000 people remain missing a full ten days after the glacier-collapse flood.
